Mac Flow — your Mac’s notch, alive.
Mac Flow uses this to play, pause and skip in Music and Spotify, and to switch Dark Mode when you ask.
Mac Flow shows your next meeting in the notch, counts down to it, and gives you a one-click Join button.
Mac Flow listens while you hold the notch to talk to Flow, and — only if you start notes — during a meeting. It’s transcribed on this Mac; audio is never saved or sent.
Mac Flow turns what you say to Flow, and meeting notes you start, into text — on this Mac only.
When you start meeting notes, Mac Flow transcribes the other people in the call from your Mac’s audio, on this Mac. Audio is never saved or sent.
Mac Flow’s Mirror shows a live camera preview in the notch so you can check yourself before a call. Video never leaves your Mac.
Mac Flow shows AirPods and other Bluetooth devices as they connect, with their battery levels.
Mac Flow uses your approximate location to show local weather in the notch.

Mac Flow watches your Downloads folder to show download progress and let you open finished files from the notch.
